updates.note: Revenue guidance was initially INR 4,500 crores, subsequently toned down to INR 4,000 crores, and actual revenue came in around INR 3,626 crores.
updates.quote: In the third quarter, I think we have turned out to saying about INR4,000 crores because of a few delays.

updates.note: Working capital days stood at around 122 days in FY26, missing the sub-70 target.
updates.quote: We realized our working capital days stood at around 122 days in FY '26

new_promises.statement: Achieve PCB revenue of around INR 300 crores to INR 400 crores in FY27.
new_promises.quote: We will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

new_promises.statement: Achieve OSAT revenue of around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores in FY27.
new_promises.quote: OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

new_promises.statement: Increase NPD-led and value-added solutions contribution to nearly 30% of total revenue.
new_promises.quote: our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue
new_promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar

new_promises.statement: Grow railway business by around 20% to 25% this year.
new_promises.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25%
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
